thread:
sarah: Quick heads-up — ran into a weird flurry of structured-output rejects on the payments tool yesterday after the strict validation flip. Lots of tiny JSON schema errors, but the sample rate in the dashboard is tiny so ops missed it.
lee: Ugh. Was that during the canary window or post-rollout?
sarah: Canary still, we shipped soft-mode -> strict in eu-west for a subset of traffic. A couple of third-party adapters returned extra fields (snake_case vs camelCase) and the validator flagged them.
otto: @sarah can you paste an example payload? want to see if this is just casing or actual type mismatch.
sarah: Sure — snippet from logs: ```json
{"transaction_id":"abc123", "amount_cents":"1000", "payment_method": {"type":"card", "card_number_last4": 4242}}
``` validator expected amount_cents as integer and last4 as string.
maria: Sounds like adapter-level coercion. We should consider: 1) quick fix in adapters to stringify last4 and coerce amounts 2) short-term: permissive coercion in validator for canary 3) long-term: clearer error surfacing in Console with suggested remediation.
nate: I lean toward #3 + small adapter hotfix. If Console showed the exact mismatch and a test request that reproduces it, SE could contact the integrator before strict mode. Right now the alert was a spike in rejects with no context.
sarah: Agreed. Our current dashboard just shows reject counts + sample id. No diffs or a sample payload viewer.
lee: Also quota implications — strict rejects still consumed tokens earlier, and customers saw billing noise. We should mark these rejects as non-billable during canary -> strict transition. Anyone own that change? @deploy-bot? :sweat_smile:
deploy-bot: The billing pipeline is separate — ticket recommended. Tagging @finance-infra.
oto: For the validator side, propose a decision matrix for fallback: 
- if field mismatch type only: try best-effort coercion and tag as "coerced"
- if unknown extra fields: allow through for permissive canary but log diff
- if missing required field: reject immediately
Would let us avoid noisy rejects while we fix adapters.
maria: That sounds reasonable. But UX needs to show which requests were coerced vs accepted vs rejected. We should add a column in the per-route table and a sample payload diff view.
sarah: Minimal console mock: link to a prototype -> https://figma.redwood/r/console/validation-diff (mock). Shows incoming payload, expected schema, inline diffs, and a one-click re-send to adapter dev webhook.
nate: Nice. Also we need telemetry changes: sample more payloads when rejects spike and flag correlation with recent rollouts. Right now sampling is uniform so we miss rare errors.
lee: Proposed sampling config (short): ```yaml
validation_sampling:
  mode: adaptive
  base_rate: 0.01
  spike_rate: 0.5 # when rejects per minute > threshold
  spike_threshold: 10
  backoff_minutes: 60
```
sarah: Love adaptive sampling. Can we also add a tiny metric label: validator.result=(accepted|coerced|rejected) and validator.coercions=* to the trace so the trace explorer can filter?
maria: Yep. Add to telemetry spec doc. We should also update rollout docs to recommend enabling permissive-coercion with adaptive sampling for 48h when flipping strict validation.
oto: Operational checklist idea: before strict flip, run a compatibility job for 24h that simulates canary traffic and surfaces top-10 diffs in console. Would reduce surprises.
lee: Who owns the compatibility job? infra or eng-platform?
sarah: Platform owns it but we need infra help for data capture. @nate can you coordinate?
nate: On it. I'll open a tracker. Also will add a small PR to the validator to emit `coercion_summary` in the logs.
sarah: Great. For now, small hotfix: adapters team will stringify the last4 and coerce amount in the integrator shim. I'll escalate to solutions eng to notify integrators.
maria: I'll start the Console feature ticket for payload-diff + coerced column. Prioritize it post-canary.
lee: OK. Action items recap: nate -> tracker + telemetry tag, maria -> console ticket, otto -> validator decision-matrix PR draft, sarah -> integrator hotfix coordination + incident note.
sarah: Thanks team. If anyone sees more rejects, ping here with the sample id. :thumbsup:
